name: KPV

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The C-terminal tripeptide of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, studied preclinically for anti-inflammatory activity in gut and skin models without the pigmentary effect of the parent hormone. It has no FDA-approved product. No FDA label exists.

systems.note: Taken for anti-inflammatory effect in skin and gut; the intended effect, evidenced preclinically in keratinocyte and colitis models.
No human safety data and no product-quality control.

monitors.why: The accessible index of the anti-inflammatory effect claimed for it.
